task_message:
Case F07: segment the fibrous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 251x251x694 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case F07 is finished. Final mask saved at 195.6 mL, single connected component.

Summary of the work:
- Located the fibrous soft-tissue tumor in the distal thigh: a large, heterogeneous, lobulated mass with internal dark fibrous bands on T2, spanning roughly 19 cm cranio-caudally and bulging the limb contour.
- Seeded the model with three positive points in the mass on axial slice 460, then verified the boundary in all three planes (including zoomed mask crops at axial 400/441/480/500 and coronal/sagittal through-plane views).
- Filled holes and applied gentle morphological closing to regularize the boundary; a model refinement produced a single-component mask (v4) that follows the lesion edge.
- Reviewed the final five-slice-per-plane panels: no lesion tissue visible past either end of the mask, no stray components, and all three automatic candidates (whole-limb intensity rings of fat/normal muscle) were correctly rejected.
- Confidence: medium — the lesion boundary is clear centrally, though its heterogeneous periphery makes the exact margin somewhat subjective.
